lookups.text:
External data: combined_lookups.csv. The emission-factor records remain outside the KPI library; this lookup stores only the data contract and selection rules.

Source file: C:/repos/atspt-emission-factors/data/outputs/combined_lookups.csv
Methodology: ATSPT Emission Factors Memo_DRAFT.docx, October 2026, Section 3. This reference documents the data dependency; it does not embed or automatically load the local file.

CSV format (column names and order):

pollutant,source,unit,year,county,vehicle_type,area_access_type,speed_bin,dataset,power_type,output

Filter source = running. Return the output column in g/vehicle-mile. Resolve each VehicleGroup and Power Type separately. Electric running factors include generation-related CO2. Running speed is supplied in mph.

Global vehicle-group labels map to CSV keys: Regular → regular; Medium Truck → medium_truck; Heavy Truck → heavy_truck.

Select conformity for non-electric VOC and NOx; toolkit for non-electric SO2, CO2 and PM2.5; assumptions for electric vehicles. Never add factors from different datasets. Map Area Access Type Rural Restricted / Rural Unrestricted / Urban Restricted / Urban Unrestricted to RR / RU / UR / UU. Map Electric / Non Electric to electric / non_electric.

Use exact entries where available. For intermediate years and speeds use linear interpolation between the nearest available entries within the same pollutant, dataset, power, county, vehicle and road-type series (bilinear interpolation when both vary). Blank dimensions are wildcards, not zero or missing. The county key all is a preweighted regional alternative, never an extra county to sum or a silent fallback. County 48339 has no 2026 entry; county 48167 has no 2030 entry: bracket with that county’s nearest available years. Do not insert zero rows. Common supported analysis years are 2023–2045; non-electric running speeds must be 2.5–75 mph. Out-of-range inputs require an explicit policy, not silent extrapolation or clipping.

Read the factors from the external CSV at calculation time. Preserve the CSV dataset and unit keys. No emission-factor data rows are stored in this lookup.
